chat.placeholder: Ask DSCode, use {'@'} to add context, / for commands or skills

greeting.morning: Good morning. How can I help?
greeting.afternoon: Good afternoon. How can I help?
greeting.evening: Good evening. How can I help?
greeting.night: Up late — don't forget to rest

input.contextNotText: Only text/code files can be referenced

permission.hintAutoEdit: Edits run automatically, commands need confirmation
permission.hintPlan: Read-only analysis, changes need manual approval

command.permissionInvalid: Unknown permission mode: {value} (available: confirm / auto-edit / plan / full-access)
command.planOn: Plan mode on (/plan off to leave)

project.remoteNotReady: Remote connection is not implemented yet

diff.selectFile: Select a file to view its content
diff.restoreConfirmBody: This will restore {n} files to their state before the agent run started: modified/deleted files are written back, files created during the run are deleted. Uncommitted changes will be lost.
diff.restoreRunning: Cannot restore while the agent is running
diff.restoreNoSnapshot: No snapshot to restore (lost on app restart)
diff.commitPlaceholder: Commit message (e.g. fix: correct login redirect)

agent.approveOnceHint: Allow this time only, no further prompts
agent.approveSessionHint: Don't ask again for the same action in this session
agent.denyHint: Stop the current task and don't continue

error.no-api-key: No API key configured. Please set it on the settings page first.
error.api: API call failed. Check your API key and network, then retry.
error.network: Network error or request timeout. Please try again later.
error.running: The previous message is still being processed. Please wait or stop it first.
error.max-rounds: Maximum tool rounds reached; the task ended early.

general.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the app UI.
general.inheritProfileDesc: When starting the built-in terminal, inherit the login shell environment, proxy, Kube variables and the local terminal font where possible.
general.terminalFontDesc: Leave empty to auto-detect the system terminal configuration; a value overrides the DSCode terminal font.
general.terminalFontPlaceholder: Empty to inherit, e.g. MesloLGS NF, monospace
general.findGrepDesc: Use enhanced Find and Grep in new sessions and sessions restored after an app restart. Current sessions keep their settings; Find on Windows is unchanged.
general.httpProxyDesc: Outbound traffic from models, MCP, command tools and the app renderer goes through this proxy; empty means direct connection without reading system environment variables. Restart required after changes.
general.proxyExceptionsDesc: Requests to matching hosts connect directly, bypassing the HTTP proxy. Separate multiple rules with commas. Restart required after changes.
general.autoCompactDesc: When a run finishes and context usage reaches the threshold (relative to the provider's context window), older conversation history is compacted automatically.
general.autoCompactThresholdDesc: Trigger when context usage reaches this percentage of the window; range 50–95.

appearance.themeDesc: Choose the light or dark appearance for the app UI.

model.thinkingHint: Effort off forces thinking disabled; high/max forces it enabled with an effort.
model.maxTokensHint: Clear to restore the 256K default (aligned with official)
model.contextWindowHint: Clear to restore the 1M default (aligned with official); used for context occupancy

commands.desc: Slash commands: typing /name expands into a prompt. Built-in commands can be edited or removed.
commands.name: Command name (without /)
commands.promptPlaceholder: Text that expands into the input

memory.title: Memory
memory.desc: Long-term facts about user preferences and project conventions, injected into every conversation's system prompt.
memory.placeholder: e.g. This project uses pnpm, commit messages in Chinese

skills.desc: Skills are capability instructions: only a catalog (name + description) is injected into the system prompt; when a task matches, the agent automatically calls the skill tool to load the full instructions before executing.
skills.name: Skill name
skills.builtinSection: Built-in skills (add and use directly, or edit a copy into My skills)

hooks.desc: Run a shell command on session start/end or after a tool completes (working directory is the project).
hooks.name: Hook name

usage.apiCacheHint: DeepSeek context caching: each round in a session hits the shared prefix and the hit portion is billed at a discount. The rate covers only records created after cache tracking was enabled; legacy records (no cache data) are excluded.
usage.localCacheHint: Only identical requests (e.g. retry after interruption, repeated question) hit and replay; every round in normal chat has a different context, so a low hit rate is expected.

subagents.desc: Define switchable agent personas; selecting one runs the conversation with its system prompt.
subagents.name: Name

mcp.desc: Configure MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and list their tools.
mcp.name: Name

plugins.desc: Drop .mjs plugins into the ~/.dscode/plugins directory; they contribute slash commands after restart.

browser.enableDesc: When enabled, the agent can call the browse tool to fetch web pages for reference.

onboarding.title: Welcome to DSCode
onboarding.subtitle: Set up your API key to unlock AI coding
onboarding.howTo: How to get an API key?

onboarding.verifyInvalid: Invalid API key. Check it and try again
